description: Minimal debug scenario - 1 Alpine VM on an isolated subnet (192.168.148.0/24). Same shape as debug_scenario_a but on a different subnet, used to verify multi-scenario coexistence on a single Proxmox. dsb-vm-01 hostname (VMID 8501, IP 192.168.148.250) on vmbr148 ; built from alpine-nano template (VMID 9903). Optional admin-wazuh VM (VMID 8550, IP 192.168.142.155, vmbr142, gated by INSTALL_WAZUH, default off) deploys a Wazuh SIEM server + agent on dsb-vm-01. Optional admin-misp VM (VMID 8551, IP 192.168.142.156, vmbr142, gated by INSTALL_MISP, default off) deploys the MISP threat intel docker-compose stack from range42-catalog/03_container_layer/docker/admin/misp-standalone/. Both admin VMs use the medium template (VMID 9232, 2cpu/8gb/64gb, built on first WAZUH/MISP-enabled deploy).
